title: Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.08960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. translated_title: 面向离线视觉控制的定向时序表征
translated_abstract: 预测型世界模型为控制任务提供了紧凑的视觉表征。然而，控制需要一种与时间可达性对齐的潜在几何结构，而不仅仅是预测相似性。我们提出了面向控制的定向时序表征，该方法在冻结的LeWorldModel（LeWM）特征之上，从离线视觉轨迹中学习这种几何结构。DTRC在所学习的控制表征上构建有向时间拟度量。短程时间偏移用于校准距离尺度；自举目标将时间可达性扩展到更长的时间范围；动作条件一致性使表征与局部转移动力学对齐。所得的距离估计时间到达代价，而其在一次转移中的变化定义了相对于目标的时间进度。我们将该进度信号作为时间评论家，用于直接的目标条件策略学习。模型辅助目标还提供了额外的训练信号。
tldr: 该论文提出DTRC方法，在冻结世界模型特征之上学习与时间可达性对齐的有向时间拟度量表征，并利用其时间进度信号作为评论家，实现离线视觉目标条件策略的直接学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DTRC, which learns a directed temporal quasimetric representation aligned with temporal reachability on top of frozen world model features, and uses the resulting temporal progress signal as a critic for direct offline goal-conditioned visual policy learning.
